origin.note: Real defects run at P0 by design (D10); injected ones are taken at P0 from the placement pass (A1) and the core (A3). Same criterion for both: the supervisor routes the retried output to no retry. Descriptive; the real cell has 13 defects in 7 cells.

c6_trace.note: A grounded issue is a recommendation from a clean observe-mode strategy output; 'fires' on it is a false positive. A foreign issue is a corpus issue placed on another business; 'fires' on it is a true positive.

coupling.note: by construction at the check-class level: every class that fires has an operator
